create_ForkOnStep_wrapper: create a ForkOnStep wrapper around a CompilerEnv to enable undo functionality before each step
use_ForkOnStep_undo: use the ForkOnStep undo method to backtrack and restore the previous environment state
use_ForkOnStep_step: use the ForkOnStep step method to take an action while automatically forking the environment
use_ForkOnStep_reset: use the ForkOnStep reset method to reset the environment and clear the fork stack
use_ForkOnStep_close: use the ForkOnStep close method to close all forked environments and the wrapped environment
